title: Coordinator AgentHost first-start, readiness, and cleanup
alt: Orchestrator starts the root AgentHost only after durable run admission. Environment checks the current actor, selection, and fences before it creates the retained 1 GiB workspace and first Sandbox placement. Orchestrator then registers the runtime, requests Broker bootstrap, and calls the real Environment activation route. Readiness is committed only after current registration, placement, and Host evidence pass. Environment records each provider attempt before an external effect and saves its exact outcome under the owner lock. Unknown or unresolved calls block release and generation advance. Cleanup releases the saved placement and does not delete retained workspace data. Claim expiry permits recovery but does not prove that a provider call stopped.

steps.label: Start follows durable root and first-message admission. Direct-root and genuine P1 admission use the same path. A pending response is not readiness.

Create and verify a private 1 GiB RWX workspace at /workspace; Strict, empty consumer allowlist, and both Retain policies; verify network policy
Persist selection, options, request, positive fences, and exact provider attempt before external effects
After rechecking authority and selection, provision with the exact owner, provider/resource fences, PVC negotiation, and egress selectors
Verify RuntimeClass/PVC; create a zero-replica pool and v1beta1 claim. Save exact UIDs before resolving the attempt; replay does not renew 600 seconds.
Recheck authority, selection, and the same network policy generation before reporting readiness
Return exact placement UID, lease, fences, expiry, and source profile (static first, else authorized lease, then global default)
Resolve the selected source profile and return its current owner-bound placement context
Bootstrap request with stable operation ID and configuration hash
Validated bootstrap delivery receipt
POST /internal/runtime/v1/activate with exact registration and operation IDs
POST /runtime/v1/configure/activate
Return startup phases and exact readiness evidence after Environment revalidates registration, placement, lease, fences, and Pod UID
Return validated Ready evidence
Commit Ready under current intent fence; no model turn is sent
Cancel releases only the saved placement. It never replaces or activates the Host. Workspace data stays retained, and the intent stores no credential bytes.
After cancellation, revalidate fresh authority and selection; use the terminal run projection and exact saved placement
Release only the saved resource and provider fence; keep workspace data and require exact completion evidence
Record the exact release receipt; unresolved results remain pending and block replay
Active fence authorizes cleanup. Saved fence identifies the call. Expiry permits retry, not quiescence. Unknown results block release and fence changes.
